about: Wage epic turn-based battles as you follow Daryon and Selene on their quest to find a cure to the all-consuming Corrosion in this grand tale of hope and sacrifice.
An enthralling story filled with plot twists and heart-wrenching moments
A gorgeous fantasy world to explore
Epic battles with a unique and strategic turn-based combat system
Stunning soundtrack featuring Yasunori Mitsuda (Chrono Trigger & Xenoblade Chronicles)
Entirely voiced in English and Japanese
summary: Wage epic turn-based battles as you follow Daryon and Selene on their quest to find a cure to the all-consuming Corrosion in this grand tale of hope and sacrifice.
